title: Geomorphology
description: Landforms are a record: rivers carry grains, the grains settle, and the speed at which they settle sorts sand from silt from clay. Unlocks the Sediment Core.

puzzle.goal: A small grain of density ρ_s sinks through still water of density ρ_f and viscosity μ. It soon stops speeding up: the drag of the slow flow around it balances its weight less its buoyancy. Write the speed v at which a sphere of radius r settles.
puzzle.name: Settling speed of a small sphere
puzzle.ask: Find v in metres per second for a 0.1 mm quartz grain in water.
puzzle.method: At low speed the drag on a sphere is 6πμrv; set it equal to the weight minus buoyancy, (4/3)πr³(ρ_s − ρ_f)g.
